title: Apoptotic and Molecular Mechanisms of Carthamidin in Breast Cancer Therapy: An Integrated In Vitro and In Silico Study.
authors: Palani, Selvakumari; Joseph, John; Sridhar, Priyadharshan; Bupesh, Giridharan; Saravanan, Konda Mani; Chandrasekaran, Rajkuberan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过体外实验和分子对接探讨山茶素对乳腺癌细胞的凋亡机制，虽涉及蛋白配体对接，但对象为小分子-受体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The current study examines the anticancer properties of the chemical carthamidin in breast cancer through in-vitro and in silico analysis. This study's results demonstrated that carthamidin strongly inhibited the proliferation of MCF 7 cells in vitro, as evidenced by an IC50 value of 128.65 microg/mL at 24 h, determined using the MTT test. Laser confocal microscopy utilizing AO/EB labeling validated apoptotic effects through upregulating pro-apoptotic cell markers. At the same time, the ROS assay demonstrated elevated ROS production in the treated cells. LDH leakage was corroborated by leakage analysis, revealing high LDH levels at 100 microg/mL. The cellular growth parameters were subsequently examined via flow cytometry, showing that the cell cycle was halted in the G0/G1 phase, with 82.9% of the cells residing there. The molecular docking research demonstrated that carthamidin displayed a significant binding affinity with Notch receptors - NOTCH 1-4 and p53, with binding scores ranging from - 5.027 to - 7.402 kcal/mol. The results suggest that carthamidin has therapeutic potential in inducing apoptosis and impairing cancer cells, warranting further investigation in breast cancer treatments.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过体外（in vitro）和计算机模拟（in silico）分析，探讨了化学物质红花素（carthamidin）在乳腺癌中的抗癌特性。研究结果表明，红花素在体外强烈抑制MCF 7细胞的增殖，通过MTT试验测定，24小时时的IC50值为128.65微克/毫升。利用AO/EB标记的激光共聚焦显微镜验证了其通过上调促凋亡细胞标志物诱导的凋亡效应。同时，ROS试验显示处理细胞中ROS产生增加。LDH泄漏通过泄漏分析得到证实，在100微克/毫升浓度下显示高LDH水平。随后通过流式细胞术检查细胞生长参数，显示细胞周期停滞在G0/G1期，其中82.9%的细胞停留在此阶段。分子对接研究表明，红花素与Notch受体（NOTCH 1-4）及p53显示出显著的结合亲和力，结合分数范围从-5.027至-7.402千卡/摩尔。结果表明，红花素在诱导凋亡和损害癌细胞方面具有治疗潜力，值得在乳腺癌治疗中进一步研究。
